description: issue #864: the Core-only half of the Sprites value-position rule, and the byte-identical twin of `statement-heads-not-values`. `spec/turtles-and-sprites.md` reserves `ask`, `each`, and `tell` only within the Sprites profile, so Core-only these are three ordinary names that nothing in this program declares -- `ol-unknown-command` (`spec/tooling.md:181`), not the wrong-position `ol-bad-token` its twin reports for the very same bytes. The pair is what pins issue #864's rule as PROFILE-GATED rather than a blanket rejection, so a Core-only learner's own `define each ... end` keeps working. `ask` carries `suggestion: "abs"`, which is the did-you-mean tie-break doing its ordinary job over the Core primitive table (Levenshtein distance 2, `spec/error-model.md:145-146`); it is asserted rather than trimmed because a fixture must pin what the checker actually produces. This fixture asserts a NAME-visibility outcome, not a declaration one, so `spec/grammar.md:408`'s pending unconditional-built-in-names change (issue #841) has nothing here to invalidate. This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.
